review: Accessories, guidance, areas, blast/fragmentation, delivery modifiers and cinematic options inventoried. Formula boundaries, armor precedence, trait/catalogue integration and executable validation remain pending.

entries.acceptance: Deployed bipod permits prone bracing and reduces required strength to ceil(two thirds normal); opening/closing consumes ready. Keep deployment and stance requirements.
Mounted heavy weapon ignores strength requirement but firing forbids movement/step. Normal defenses remain. Mounting/removal takes three ready actions unless definition specifies longer.

Visible-to-user aiming dot within sight range gives +1 attack without aim; visible-to-target dot gives target +1 dodge. Activation is free but declared before aim/attack. Default range equals weapon half-damage distance; sensory bands matter.

Fixed scope requires aim seconds at least its bonus; variable scope permits proportionally reduced benefit for shorter aim. Only one scope including innate magnification applies; retain general targeting bonus caps.

Distant/out-of-sight firearm detection uses hearing+5 with authored environment/weapon adjustment from -4 to +4; typical suppression -4, best commercial -6. Exposed in-front targets within attack range hear automatically; locating suppressed shooter requires intelligence unless visible.

Guided attack ignores range penalties. Within listed speed distance launch uses attack/committed attack; farther launch uses concentration and subsequent guidance. Multi-turn flight automatically qualifies for accuracy; short-flight accuracy requires prior aim.

Guide with concentration each flight turn, maintaining target sight. Loss of sight misses automatically. Arrival requires attack or determined committed attack; unavailable action causes miss. Specify transition from guidance to arrival without charging both maneuvers.

Lock uses aim plus guided-projectile skill check. Launch uses ready, not attack; launcher preparation already included in reload must not be charged again. Resolve failed-lock launch legality explicitly from trait/equipment definitions.

Autonomous projectile attacks at ten plus accuracy for successful lock. Ignore firer injury, motion and posture, and range; use seeker senses for visibility/jamming, with target size/speed and other applicable modifiers.

Guided/homing half-damage statistic is speed, never damage reduction. Defer hit roll until arrival; expire after maximum traveled distance including launch turn. Track moving target, travel, sight/control, launch identity and autonomous ownership across saves.

Semi-active guidance needs a compatible designator maintained by firer or ally through aim and dexterity-based observation skill. Failed designation misses. Own designation and projectile separately with a shared target link.

Detailed electronic countermeasure penalties are outside supplied reference scope. Require explicit authored system compatibility/penalty definitions or reject unsupported interaction; do not invent a catalogue.

Area attacks affect every eligible target within radius, ordinarily without distance reduction. Miss scatters center. Ordinary defense does not negate area; legal retreat/dive can escape or reach cover. Oversized targets can expose only a body part.

Cone hit aims its axis; miss scatters target point but may still catch original target. Width grows by specified maximum width divided by range; unspecified width grows one yard per yard. Source says width one at origin but example uses proportional width, requiring explicit origin/boundary policy.

Fully screened targets receive normal cover, including screening by another person. Resolve actual axis, maximum extent and footprint before affected-target checks; dodge can leave area or reach cover.

Selected dissipation divides cone damage by width at target or area damage by center distance. Resistance effects instead add this divisor to health. Define zero-distance, fractional width and rounding before completion.
Deliberate ground targeting of area/explosive attacks adds four to hit with no ordinary target defense; affected actors still have permitted diving responses.

Miss displacement is failure margin capped at ceil(half target distance); a dodge uses success margin. Airborne/underwater targets or unseen artillery/drop attacks use squared failure margin, but not squared dodge margin. Reconcile cap precedence for squared case.
One die selects six directions relative to facing: one forward, subsequent values clockwise by sixty degrees. Persist impact location; do not reroll for separate effects of same projectile.

Blast collateral extent is twice effective damage dice in yards, including expression multipliers. Direct target takes listed damage; others divide rolled damage by three times distance rounding down. Zero-distance/contact and internal blasts use explicit separate branches.

B414 says torso armor for blast while general area rules refer to exposed-location average. Preserve discrepancy and document precedence. Direct-hit armor divisor does not reduce collateral protection.

Roll damage separately per target by default; author may select shared nonplayer rolls as a speed option. Explosion can ignite materials and permits diving response; do not conflate fragment and blast damage.

Fragment radius is five times fragment dice. Direct target automatically hit; others attacked at fifteen modified only by distance, posture and size, gaining another hit per three success margin. Each hit uses random location, cutting damage and cover; blast divisor does not apply.
Airburst fragment targeting ignores posture advantage and only overhead cover protects. Actual detonation altitude and exposure must be retained.

Loose material can produce incidental fragment profile from 1d-4 through 1d. Author supplies actual debris and profile before resolution; absence of listed fragments does not imply arbitrary automatic fragments.

Special burning fragments typically inflict 1d with divisor .2 every ten seconds for one minute. Record retained fragments, scheduled ticks and actual removal/protection contract; no duplicate initial tick.

Underwater collateral divisor uses distance, vacuum/trace uses ten times distance, ordinary air three times distance. Other pressures need specified authored treatment; do not infer continuous interpolation.

Actor covering explosive takes maximum possible damage through normal armor. Others gain that actor’s torso protection plus health as cover. Resolve protective response before blast without regenerating cover from post-blast remaining health unless source requires it.
Internal detonation bypasses armor and uses vital-organ factor three. Link to actual successful internal delivery rather than treating every follow-up as an explosion.

Game charge profile uses six-die multiplier and reference relative-force coefficient: required abstract weight n*n/(4*coefficient), inverse multiplier square-root(weight*4*coefficient). Preserve units, rounding policy and game-only scope; exclude real-world fabrication/composition guidance.

Non-damaging effect uses modified health resistance, normally adding applicable armor. Divisors and penetration modifiers can change that bonus; penetrating carrier removes armor bonus for its internal follow-up. Each effect needs concrete condition/duration behavior.

Linked condition resistance occurs on hit regardless of damage penetration. Injury-triggered side effect instead requires injury, usually resistance penalty one per two injury; use actual definition and rounding.
Blood-agent delivery needs wound or mucous-membrane access; otherwise no effect. Resolve detailed trait restrictions and exposure before resistance.
Contact requires bare skin or porous clothing; armor stops it except skin-limited protection. Area/cone contact effects instead reach anyone lacking sealed protection. Use actual suit/trait state.
Inhaled effect bypasses armor but fails against held breath, supplied air, suitable respirator/filter or nonbreathing physiology. Link to actual breathing state and exposure duration.
Sense-mediated attack only reaches users of the specified sense; resolve actual senses and trait-specific protection, not ordinary armor alone.
Every cinematic procedure is individually selected in campaign context, default off. Including all libraries must not activate them or silently change random consumption.

Optional appearance-qualified attire defense grants one for exposed limbs/torso, two for minimal clothing, with printed sex-specific additional one and unclothed movement bonuses one ground/two water. Require explicit authored eligibility policy preserving stated source scope rather than automatic body inspection.

Optional minor-opponent designation forces failed defenses, prohibits committed attack and collapses on any penetration; author selects unconscious/dead. Skip damage dice only when penetration is certain. Shared actor state still records actual incapacity.

Optional spectacle blast removes direct damage/fragments, causing knockback with one crushing injury per yard. Reconcile knockback source magnitude and collisions explicitly rather than running ordinary explosion injury as well.
Optional piercing knockback uses crushing procedure; any knockback additionally requires intelligence at -1 per yard or mental stun next turn. Avoid repeated checks for one displacement event.

Immediately after damage, optional one-point spend reduces an attack’s aggregate health/fatigue loss including burst hits to one. Authored debt permitted only explicitly; use advancement ledger and reverse superseded wound consequences atomically.

Optional player ammunition replenishment supplies spare rounds/cells when carried supply exhausted and suppresses malfunctions. Distinguish reserve replenishment from reload or magically refilling loaded chamber; validate selected behavior.

Optional opponent conduct limits engagement to one adversary at a time against player melee/unarmed fighter, with specified monster behavior favoring displacement/restraint. Author scheduler must enforce permissions, not merely narrate intent.

Optional failed-defense conversion costs one fatigue and next turn, covers entire lethal attack including burst. Exclude ordinary crushing/no-damage unarmed/melee/thrown attacks unless skull/neck, and exclude possessions. Preserve actual available fatigue and skipped-turn state.

Optional ordinary attack can use two hands simultaneously with eligible unarmed/one-handed/pistol modes. Each -4 plus off-hand -4 unless exempted/trained. Roll separately; same target defends -1, distinct melee targets must be adjacent. Replace only one existing attack; remaining attacks stay single. Reconcile simultaneous consequences and rapid-strike exclusion.
